title: Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis and methotrexate
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's arthritis and related long-term drug therapy.
note:
Chief Complaint
Joint pain and stiffness.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y.o. female presenting for f/u of rheumatoid arthritis. She reports persistent aching and morning stiffness. Symptoms are managed with conservative measures. Denies recent flares or significant changes in mobility. She notes that physical therapy has been helpful for maintaining range of motion.

Medication List
Acetaminophen 650mg BID PRN.

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Resp: CTAB.
MSK: Symmetric joint tenderness noted. No acute erythema or warmth.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3.

Assessment
1. Rheumatoid arthritis. Pt is currently stable on non-pharmacological management and analgesics.

Plan
1. Continue current acetaminophen regimen for pain.
2. Continue physical therapy 2x/week.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: Rheumatoid arthritis, nothing more specified: M06.9 (HCC 93).

distractors.why: Rheumatoid factor status is not documented.
